profile.headline: Leadership | Innovation | Software | Engineering
profile.summary:
I'm a tech leader with a passion for innovation and a track record of driving strategic change. From leading executive strategy teams to overhauling organizations, I've always been drawn to solving complex problems and pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

Over the years, I've had the opportunity to work on some truly exciting projects, including developing hardware and software systems to collect state-of-the-art data from moving vehicles, inventing methodologies to automate the processing of fused 2D and 3D geospatial data sets, and helping to advance the global knowledge of connected and automated vehicles.

Nowadays, I work with strategic executives to build product roadmaps, curate critical partnerships and create and validate innovative business models - including new-to-the-world technologies and markets.

Ultimately, my mission is to help companies build amazing teams focused on inventing and realizing the future. I'm always looking for new opportunities to collaborate and make a positive impact, so don't be shy - drop me a line, and let's chat!

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Staff Software Engineer at The Weather Company, I lead the charge in developing cutting-edge software solutions that enhance the precision and reliability of our weather predictions. My key responsibilities include:

* Working with a talented team of engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and excellence.
* Designing and implementing robust software systems that process vast quantities of meteorological data.
* Working closely with data scientists, meteorologists, and other cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of new technologies, and translating stakeholder needs into actionable technical requirements.
* Driving initiatives to enhance software performance, ensuring our systems are highly available, scalable, and reliable.
* Championing best practices in software development, including code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines, to maintain the highest standards of quality and efficiency.
* Actively participating in strategic planning and decision-making, aligning our technology roadmap with the company’s business objectives to drive forward our mission of delivering unparalleled weather insights.

In this role, I am committed to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in meteorological science, leveraging technology to provide more accurate and timely weather information that serves millions of users worldwide.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Engineering · Big Data Analytics · Cloud Computing · Go (Programming Language) · AWS · Kubernetes · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Associate Editor
positions.description:
I'm an Associate Editor for SAE's Journal of Connected and Automated Vehicles, a role I'm passionate about. The journal is a leading publication in the field of connected and automated vehicles, and I'm thrilled to be a part of the team that helps to shape its content and direction.

As an Associate Editor, I have the opportunity to review and edit articles submitted to the journal, working with authors to ensure that their work is of the highest quality and meets the standards of the publication. I also contribute to the editorial process, helping to select and curate relevant, interesting, and valuable content for our readers.

It's an exciting role, and I'm always looking for new ways to engage with the community and contribute to the advancement of knowledge in this rapidly-evolving field.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Technical Vision · Communication · Product Marketing · Business Management · Business Development

positions.title: Director
positions.description:
As Director at Wisconsin ACES, I was privileged to lead an organization dedicated to advancing the understanding and adoption of automated, connected, electric, and shared (ACES) mobility technologies. My tenure was marked by several key achievements:

* Directed the strategic vision and initiatives of Wisconsin ACES, aligning efforts with our mission to foster the safe, equitable, and widespread adoption of ACES technologies. Worked collaboratively with the board to develop and implement forward-thinking policies and strategies.
* Led advocacy efforts to promote unbiased, technically accurate discussions about ACES mobility. Organized and participated in events, workshops, and conferences, educating the public and engaging stakeholders on the benefits and challenges of ACES technologies.
* Contributed to significant research projects and publications that advanced the knowledge and application of ACES technologies, positioning Wisconsin ACES as a thought leader in the field.
* Established and nurtured strategic partnerships with industry leaders, academic institutions, and government bodies, enhancing the reach and impact of Wisconsin ACES.
* Facilitated inclusive and comprehensive discussions on ACES technologies, ensuring diverse perspectives were represented and considered in our advocacy and educational efforts.

In this role, I was committed to driving positive change in the world of transportation, leveraging my expertise to make a meaningful impact on the adoption of innovative mobility solutions. My experience at Wisconsin ACES has equipped me with a deep understanding of the challenges and opportunities in the ACES landscape, and I look forward to continuing to contribute to this transformative field.

positions.title: Chief Innovation Officer
positions.description:
As Chief Innovation Officer at Mandli, I have the privilege of leading a team of creative thinkers focused on building and maintaining our portfolio of innovative product and service ideas.

In this role, I'm responsible for developing business relationships, identifying problems, proposing and prototyping potential solutions, and guiding our core business as we develop and scale new ideas.

But my role doesn't stop there - as a member of the executive team, I also provide strategic input on where we should (and shouldn't) focus our efforts, what our strategic priorities should be, and what future capabilities will best position us as markets and technologies advance.

It's a challenging and exciting role, and I'm always looking for new opportunities to help Mandli stay ahead of the curve and deliver value to our customers.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
As Chief Technology Officer at Mandli Communications, I had the opportunity to shape the company's technological direction and drive innovation in all that we do.

In this role, I conducted research to improve our technological assets, maintain quality, and ensure all of our products meet the highest standards. I also managed our IT and engineering budgets to make sure we were being smart about how we spent our resources.

One of my key responsibilities was to continuously evaluate our systems' technical efficiency and make necessary changes to keep us at the forefront of our industry. This often involved identifying technological trends and implementing changes to our existing technology.

I was also responsible for communicating and presenting to our CEO and other C-level staff and providing leadership and support to our directors and team owners. It was a challenging and rewarding role, and I always looked for ways to help Mandli achieve its mission and deliver value to our customers.

positions.title: Director of Technology
positions.description:
As Director of Technology at Mandli Communications, I had the opportunity to drive significant innovation and growth for the company.

One of my key achievements was designing and implementing processes and infrastructure that supported the largest innovation the company had ever seen, leading to over 300% growth in sales revenue in just four years.

I also led the first team in the U.S.A. to successfully integrate GPS, LiDAR, Photolog Imaging, Pavement Roughness, Rutting, and Distress into a highway-speed data collection system, which resulted in several million dollars in contracts and helped to advance Mandli's capabilities in this area.

In addition to these achievements, I built and led a product management and development team of 16 employees, lowering turnover rates from over 50% to under 5% average for each year during the company's largest growth ever. It was an exciting and rewarding role, and I'm proud of the impact I was able to have at Mandli.

positions.title: Electrical/Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Standardized core system infrastructure and processes leading to greatly increased reliability, and functional capabilities, and markedly reduced manufacturing time, mishaps, support time, and operational downtime.
• Developed one of the world’s first vertical clearance measurement systems used to accurately measure the vertical clearance of structures from highway-speed vehicles leading to several million dollars in contracts.
• Developed software for several new data acquisition sensors, including laser profiling and pavement imaging sensors, providing Mandli greatly increased product functionality and market access.

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description:
• Designed and upgraded network storage systems from 4 Terabytes to over 200 Terabytes.
• Implemented new systems to increase capabilities throughout the organization including document management, ￼￼￼project management, database, HR tracking and reporting, and collaboration systems.

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description:
As a Computer Technician at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, I had the opportunity to work on a variety of exciting and challenging projects.

One of my key responsibilities was overseeing the operation of statistics tracking and reporting software for NCAA sporting events. This involved ensuring that the software was running smoothly, troubleshooting any issues that arose, and working with a diverse team of stakeholders to deliver timely and accurate reports.

I also helped with large-scale departmental OS upgrades on two separate occasions, which required careful planning and coordination to ensure that all of the computers were upgraded efficiently and effectively.

positions.title: Website Programmer
positions.description:
As a Website Programmer at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, I had the opportunity to work on some truly exciting projects.

One of my key achievements was developing a 5000+ page website as part of a small team of programmers over a three-month period. This required careful planning, coordination, and coding skills to deliver a high-quality website that met the needs of our users.

I also developed a database and reusable software frameworks that significantly lowered website coding and maintenance time, and greatly increased reliability for a website with millions of visitors per month. This was a significant accomplishment that helped us to streamline our processes and improve the user experience.

In addition to these projects, I also designed, developed, and deployed trivia software for Bucky's Trivia Extravaganza, which helped to track and display participating teams' scores in real-time. It was a fun and rewarding project, and I'm proud of the impact it had on the event.

projects.title: Agile Transformation
projects.description:
Description: The Agile Transformation Project was a major undertaking that aimed to revamp the company's organizational structure and processes to align with an agile methodology. The project involved analyzing primary company processes, designing new team structures, defining team values based on corporate values, and prioritizing team creation while company operations were in flight.

Role: As the leader of the project, my responsibilities included leading a team in designing, planning, and implementing the organizational transformation, revamping and analyzing primary company processes, designing new team structures, documenting and disseminating team values, and prioritizing team creation.

Skills and Tools: The skills and tools used in this project include Agile methodologies, project management, team leadership, process improvement, and change management.

Results: The results of the Agile Transformation Project were impressive, with significant reductions in team waste and a focus on continuous improvement baked into team operations from the start. Exception reporting was streamlined, ensuring that the executive team was aware of critical issues every morning, and teams were clearly aligned with corporate goals. The increased operational flexibility of the teams led to boosts in morale and overall company productivity. Team members were generally happier, and the company as a whole saw large improvements as a result of the transformation. I am proud of the impact the Agile Transformation Project has had and the skills and knowledge I developed during its execution, it was an amazing success that has transformed the way the company operates.

projects.title: Automated 3d Sign Face Detection
projects.description:
Description: The Automated 3d Sign Face Detection project was a fun project that required the use of Python and data analysis skills to solve a complex problem. The project aimed to streamline the process of characterizing the response of lidar sensors on various retroreflective surfaces by automating the process of extracting and analyzing sign faces moving through a 3d point cloud over time.

Role: As a member of the project team, I was responsible for using a combination of Python tools, including plane detection and DBSCAN clustering for the face, and OPTICS for the location and orientation clustering, to develop a script that could automatically extract all of the relevant information, including 3d bounding boxes, face normals, entrance angles, and sign orientation, and export it to a file for further analysis.

Skills and Tools: The project required the use of various technical skills, including data analysis, Python programming, and knowledge of plane detection and DBSCAN clustering for the face, and OPTICS for the location and orientation clustering.

Results: The Automated 3d Sign Face Detection project resulted in a powerful tool that significantly reduced the time and effort required to characterize the performance of lidar sensors on different retroreflective surfaces. The project was a great opportunity for me to refine my skills in Python and data analysis.
